messages.issues.ROUTE_TOO_SHORT: The cleaned route needs at least two distinct points and a length of 0.1 m.
messages.issues.DUPLICATE_COORDINATES: Consecutive duplicate coordinates were merged without changing traversal order. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_CONFLICT: Conflicting elevations at repeated coordinates are marked missing. Explicitly fill short gaps or omit elevation. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_MISSING: Some route points have no elevation. Zero elevation is preserved as valid data. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.LARGE_SOURCE_EDGE: Some adjacent source coordinates are more than 1 km apart. Check their connections on the map. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.GEOMETRY_RESOURCE_LIMIT: This route requires too many geometry nodes for the browser processing budget.
messages.issues.GEOMETRY_QUANTIZATION_COLLISION: Stage boundaries cannot be represented by distinct E7 geometry nodes. Move a boundary or disable its stage split.
messages.issues.GEOMETRY_QUANTIZATION_MERGE: Coincident geometry nodes were resolved after coordinate quantization. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.INCOMPLETE_ELEVATION: A complete elevation profile is unavailable. Only explicitly requested interior gaps of at most {{limit}} m can be filled; endpoints and longer gaps cannot be extrapolated.
messages.issues.PROFILE_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Elevation sampling exceeds 200,000 nodes. Increase the sampling interval.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_RANGE: An elevation value exceeds the RTE signed 32-bit decimeter range.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_TOTAL_RANGE: Cumulative ascent or descent exceeds the RTE unsigned 32-bit decimeter range.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_FILLED: Interior elevation gaps of at most {{limit}} m were explicitly filled by distance-based linear interpolation.
messages.issues.IDENTITY_INVALID: The route identity or revision is invalid.
messages.issues.ROUTE_NAME_INVALID: The route name must contain 1–96 UTF-8 bytes and no control characters.
messages.issues.SOURCE_HASH_INVALID: The source SHA-256 must contain exactly 32 bytes.
messages.issues.DISTANCE_RANGE: The route distance is outside the RTE range.
messages.issues.OPTIONS_INVALID: Invalid settings: geometry tolerance 0–1000 m, elevation interval 0.1–1000 m, smoothing window 0–10000 m.
messages.issues.STATION_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm this station’s along-route visit before exporting. ({{name}})
messages.issues.STATION_NAME_INVALID: A station name or short label exceeds its UTF-8 byte limit or contains invalid characters. ({{name}})
messages.issues.STATION_INVALID: A station has invalid event fields or coordinates. ({{name}})
messages.issues.EVENT_ID_DUPLICATE: Station event IDs must be unique.
messages.issues.ENDPOINT_EVENTS: Exactly one start and finish must be the first and last events, at zero and the total distance, both defining stage boundaries.
messages.issues.BOUNDARY_COLLISION: Stage boundaries coincide after decimeter quantization. Move one or disable its stage split.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm that KML altitude values represent route ground elevation, or omit elevation.
